resources.string: Select one or more photos (up to %1$d). Swipe to edit each photo, then save them all.
Blank fields stay hidden. All detected values can be edited.
Pixel values refer to an 859 px short edge. Photo orientation and export resolution scale the card consistently.
100% uses the reference text size. Enlarging text keeps the card width.
The default card font is included in this build when available. Imported fonts stay in private app storage; Reset restores the default.
Rendering the original photo. Keep the app open.
Keep capture metadata, excluding still-image GPS

Supported JPEGs retain Ultra HDR and Motion Photo video. PNG is available only for ordinary still images. Unsupported auxiliary formats stop export. Only the cover changes; untouched video may retain its own metadata.
The card is taller than the photo. Reduce card scale or shorten the text. No text has been truncated.
There is not enough memory for this photo. Close other apps or choose a smaller image. Export resolution has not been reduced.
Saved for future imports when EXIF has no photographer. Editing one photo does not change this default.
Save and apply to current photo
Resolve photo GPS to a place

Sends photo coordinates to the Android system place-name service, which may use the network. It does not read your current location or upload the photo. English city and country names are requested. Exported EXIF still excludes GPS.
Configure device-specific lens names, focal ranges and zoom endpoints. No device names or focal mappings are hardcoded.
Optional. Applies to future imports from unknown devices. Leave blank to show focal length only when zoom is unknown.
Enter a number from 1 to 200, or leave blank.
Resolving photo location… You can keep editing.
Place resolved from photo GPS. You can edit it.
No place returned. Check the network, retry, or enter it manually.
No readable GPS in this photo. Try importing the original from Files, or enter a place manually.
Automatic place lookup is off in Settings.
Uses the photo GPS, not your current location.
Scan the lenses exposed by the system without taking a photo. Hidden lenses can be added manually.
Scan unavailable. You can still add profiles manually.
Some characteristics could not be read. This is not a complete hardware inventory.
Match the device/model text in the photo. Names remain editable and only missing metadata is filled.
This container cannot yet be exported with all auxiliary data intact. The original stays unchanged; export is blocked instead of flattening it.
Preserving this Ultra HDR image requires Android 14 or later.
Use JPEG to preserve the HDR gainmap or Motion Photo video. PNG cannot contain these parts.
The platform could not decode the HDR gainmap. Export stopped to prevent HDR loss.
The encoded HDR data failed verification. No result was published.
The exported media container failed verification. No result was published.
Edit a photo information card, match saved lens profiles, and preserve supported Ultra HDR and Motion Photo data.
Scan visible lenses or edit names, ranges and zoom mappings.
Add a lens profile to fill missing lens names and magnification when you import photos.
For a fixed lens, use the same value at both ends.
Optional. Fill both endpoints or leave both blank.
Optional actual focal lengths from Camera2 or EXIF, not 35mm-equivalent values. Leave blank if unknown.
Device, lens name and a valid equivalent range are required. Optional ranges need both endpoints.
The upper value must not be smaller than the lower value.
Enter a positive number no greater than %1$d.
JPEG quality: %1$d/100. Original pixel dimensions are preserved.
Returning will discard changes that you have not saved.
Open photos and unsaved edits will be cleared. Any ongoing save will stop; photos already saved remain in your gallery.
Select up to %1$d photos at a time.
Each of the %1$d photos keeps its original pixel dimensions.
